title.zh: 多格式内容与演讲备注

text.zh: 同一汇报的 PPT、HTML、Markdown 保持核心事实、结论和结构主线一致，按载体调整详略。PPT 内容页提供讲解要点及必要的页间衔接，逐页检查。Markdown 用标题、列表和必要引用组织内容；表格遵循当前所选表格规则。最终材料不夹入制作或纠错过程。
text.en: The PPT, HTML and Markdown versions of one report keep the same core facts, conclusions and structural main line, with detail adjusted to the medium. Content slides of a PPT provide talking points and the necessary transitions between slides, checked slide by slide. Markdown uses headings, lists and necessary quotations to organize content; tables follow the currently selected table rule. Final materials do not include the making or correction process.

zh: 仅在制作或检查汇报时适用
en: Only when producing or reviewing reports

trigger.zh: 同一汇报同时制作 PPT、HTML、Markdown 等多种载体时
trigger.en: When one report is produced in several media such as PPT, HTML and Markdown

purpose.zh: 让各载体的事实、结论与主线一致，并便于讲解
purpose.en: Keep facts, conclusions and the main line consistent across media and make the report easy to present

exclude.zh: 制作或纠错过程（不进入最终材料）
exclude.en: The making or correction process (it stays out of final materials)
